title: DecryptionEvent
description: Immutable decryption provenance event contract signed by recipient using ML-DSA

event_id.description: Unique UUIDv4 identifying this specific decryption event

document_id.description: Canonical identifier or SHA-256 hash of the confidential source document

recipient_id.description: Public identifier / fingerprint of authorized recipient identity

session_id.description: Decryption session identifier bound to local authentication state

watermark_id.description: Unique identifier of the forensic watermark embedded into the decrypted instance

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the decryption operation

watermark_hash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the raw watermark payload bytes

signature_algorithm.description: Post-quantum digital signature algorithm used for non-repudiation

signature.description: Base64 or hex-encoded ML-DSA signature over canonical serialization of event fields
